title: South Africa has three official capitals
body: South Africa divides its capital functions among three cities. The administration is based in Pretoria, Parliament sits in Cape Town, and the Supreme Court of Appeal sits in Bloemfontein, the judicial capital.
takeaway: The country's highest court sits in a fourth city. The Constitutional Court is in Johannesburg.
source: South African Government, South Africa at a glance
visual: the columned facade of South Africa's Parliament in Cape Town, with Table Mountain behind it
